ns2:course.label: Sys & Integrative Physiol Lab
ns2:course.description: Experimental investigation of organ systems of vertebrates with emphasis on biochemical, electrical and physical recording techniques. Some animal dissection and the use of animal tissues are required in this course. Alternatives are not available. Inquiries concerning the use of, or the dissection of animal tissues can be directed to the instructor or Head of the Department. 2 undergraduate hours. 1 graduate hour. Prerequisite: Credit or concurrent registration in MCB 402 and previous biology laboratory experience.
